source: RETC MMA — Emisiones al aire de fuentes puntuales

columns.hm_pb_kg: Mean annual Pb air emissions from point sources [kg/yr]
columns.hm_mn_kg: Mean annual Mn air emissions from point sources [kg/yr]
columns.hm_as_kg: Mean annual As air emissions from point sources [kg/yr]
columns.hm_cd_kg: Mean annual Cd air emissions from point sources [kg/yr]
columns.hm_hg_kg: Mean annual Hg air emissions from point sources [kg/yr]
columns.hm_pb_log: log1p(hm_pb_kg) — log-transformed Pb for brain-health models
columns.hm_as_log: log1p(hm_as_kg) — log-transformed As for brain-health models
columns.n_sources: Unique industrial establishments with heavy metal declarations

note_mn_cd: Manganeso (Mn) and Cadmio (Cd) are absent from RM RETC declarations: their industrial sources are in other regions (e.g. Atacama, Maule). Both columns are 0 for all 52 RM communes — this is a real data finding.
